title: Draft order updates from changing store data

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare customer-facing order status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently

ease.reason: A student can draft from operator-supplied sample order facts, but no implementation reference is attached.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: online shops may pay for clearer order updates; this request establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can draft from synthetic status changes, while live data access and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed trigger could prepare drafts, but a person must verify changing facts and approve every message.

evidence.reason: The request names customer-facing updates and incomplete or changing data, but not frequency, fields or implementation.

reason: Assessed a bounded draft-from-sample-data experiment. Rejected as a duplicate of recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6: both target online shops and handling customer support communications; its provisional mean is also below 6.
